subject: CAIQ response sprint retrospective + evidence binder
messages:
From: Jane Walters <jw@polarisbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Polaris Bank Security Team <polaris-sec@polarisbank.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ - consolidated evidence bundle request

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we discussed on the call, Polaris needs a consolidated CAIQ response set along with a single evidence binder we can hand to our internal auditors. Primary asks: a) the completed CAIQ spreadsheet with control annotations (why a control is met / compensating control where applicable), b) an index that points to artifacts (policy, screenshots, logs) and c) a zipped evidence package with redacted logs.

Timing: auditors want materials by EOD Tuesday (2026-12-15). I know that’s tight — we’re flexible on format as long as references are clear.

Can you confirm owner for each control group and an internal SLA for final deliverables? If there are blockers (3rd-party attestations, data retention pulls) flag them and we’ll coordinate exceptions.

Regards,
Jane Walters
Senior Information Risk Manager
Polaris Bank

Attachment: request_summary.pdf (1 page)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Walters <jw@polarisbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ - consolidated evidence bundle request

Jane — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can meet EOD Tue with a consolidated binder. Quick plan below (owners in parentheses):

- Annotated CAIQ spreadsheet (rachel_kim): populate CSA control IDs, short rationale, and pointer to artifact name in the index. Will deliver v1 by Mon AM.
- Evidence binder zip (marissa_cole): gather PDFs/screenshots and the redacted logs. Working with infra to pull 30/90-day extracts (david_kim).
- Control owner confirmations (david_kim): small blurbs from engineering owners for high-risk controls (networking, key management).

Blockers we foresee: SOC 2 report scoping for one 3rd-party subservice — we’ll note that as 'pending third-party attestation' in the index.

I’ll also include a short runbook for future CAIQ requests so your auditors can reuse artifacts with timestamped extracts (we’ll version snapshots).

Deliverables we’ll attach: polaris_caiq_annotated.xlsx, evidence_binder_v3.zip, audit_log_extract_202611.csv.

If that plan looks good I’ll kick off the sprint and send hourly touchpoints on Monday.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Looping in Priyom for the artifact index automation. A few clarifications from the evidence ops side:

- For any control citing 'configuration as code' (IaC), we’ll include the repo commit hash + cookbook snippet rather than full repo access.
- Redaction policy: we’ll redact account IDs and PII; logs will include timestamps and event IDs only.
- We should mark controls that rely on runtime caching/kv with an operational note (expected TTLs) — auditors often ask for that.

Rachel — I started the binder skeleton and added a 'how to re-run extract' section. Jane — can you confirm auditor preference for CSV vs PDF lists for index references? We can provide both if you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick notes from the automation side:

- I’ll generate the control-index CSV automatically from our internal tracker and map it to the CAIQ IDs. Output will be named polaris_caiq_annotated.xlsx and include columns: control_id, redwood_response, artifact_name, artifact_path, owner, last_updated.
- ETA: automated CSV -> XLSX by Mon 17:00 PT; manual owner confirmations to be appended Tue morning.
- Owner questions: David, can you confirm whether key rotation doc (KM-002) is in the public policy repo or gated (I have a note saying gated). If gated, we’ll include a redacted PDF and a contact for the attestation.

I’ll also add a short runbook inside the binder: 'How auditors validate a CAIQ bundle (steps + expected artifacts)'.

—Priyom
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Walters <jw@polarisbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ - consolidated evidence bundle request (final)

Jane — attaching the final deliverables per the timeline. Summary / retrospective notes below: 

- Deliverables: polaris_caiq_annotated.xlsx (fully mapped, 280 controls), evidence_binder_v3.zip (policies, redacted logs, screenshots), audit_log_extract_202611.csv (30/90 day slices).
- Outstanding: KM-002 (key rotation) is gated behind KMS audit logs accessible only to SRE and InfoSec; we included a redacted export and an owner attestation from David.
- Lessons learned for next sprint: index should include a short example row at the top to show auditors how to follow references; automate inclusion of doc commit hashes for policy artifacts; pre-run redaction script earlier to avoid last-minute fixes.
- Follow-up: I scheduled a 30-minute retro on Thursday (2026-12-17 10:00 PT) to lock the runbook and agree on an org-level SLA for CAIQ requests.

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Jane, please confirm receipt and whether auditors want any extra native logs.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
